description: Corrections to the Prop 123 Land Banking rows of ledger.json, keyed by fiscal year and the ledger's own (wrong) project name. scripts/funding/build_land_banking_awards.py applies them and stops if any corrected value is missing from the round's PDF text or if a key matches no ledger row. printed_as gives the pieces of a cell that the PDF prints on separate lines, joined by ' | '. An entry with only a note leaves the row as the ledger read it and adds the note. Two optional fields change only what readers see: show_project / show_sponsor give the name as it should read when the printed one has a typo or a shortened name (the printed row stays in source_quote), and since gives one dated, sourced line on what has happened to the site after the award.

since.text: The site is 1130 and 1138 18 1/2 Road in Fruita. CHFA committed the grant on May 16, 2025, and the city closed on the land in November 2025. The city says it plans mostly entry-level single-family homes for sale, with some apartments. Under the grant, the homes must be permitted and their construction loan closed within ten years of the land purchase.
since.quote: for the acquisition of land for the development of The Fruita Commons, located at 1138 18 1/2 Rd. and 1130 18 1/2 Rd., Fruita, Mesa County, CO, 81521 ... Within 10 years of the Closing (“Final Deadline”), the Project must obtain all necessary permits, and the construction loan for the Project must be closed and funded ... we closed on the purchase of the Fruita Commons property in the northeast part of Fruita ... The focus of the property will be to provide entry-level single-family detached workforce housing units for sale, with some multifamily units as well.

sources.title: CHFA grant commitment, May 16, 2025 (City of Fruita Resolution 2025-22, Attachment 1)
